mapping_json.fidelity_notes: Dual-weapon kit — two skills warranted. Freeze attested per §B5-ROGUELITE exception (enemy status verb, not element type). HP-halving mechanic has no engine lane — noted as delivery. Damage cap at 10 has no engine lane — noted as resource_economy. This is the most mechanically novel VS kit in the batch: a two-weapon defensive-offense combo for specific boss-kill. Capstone row populated with Reaper-kill tech detail.
